blocks.heading: Defense Technology (The Pentagon of the West)
paragraphs: Colorado Springs hosts an extraordinary concentration of military commands — NORAD, NORTHCOM, US Space Command (reactivated 2019), US Space Force (established 2019), and Army Space and Missile Defense Command. The commercial defense technology community serving these commands creates AI demand:

Defense contractor ecosystem: Lockheed Martin (Schriever support), Raytheon (Colorado Springs operations), Boeing (Peterson support), L3Harris, and dozens of defense technology companies serving Colorado Springs's military installations. ClickMasters builds commercial AI for these companies' non-classified business operations: Manufacturing quality control for defense component manufacturers. Supply chain analytics for defense contractor supply chains. Business intelligence and reporting AI for defense contractor commercial operations.
Classified and ITAR-restricted technical work is outside ClickMasters' scope.
Cost: $30,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Space and Commercial Space Operations
paragraphs: The US Space Force's Commercial Space Office and Colorado Springs's growing commercial space community — Aerospace Corporation (El Segundo HQ but major Colorado Springs presence), Colorado Space Business Roundtable member companies, and the entrepreneurial commercial space companies attracted by Space Force's Colorado Springs headquarters:
Commercial satellite analytics: Telemetry data analysis, anomaly detection, and mission planning optimization for Colorado Springs's commercial satellite operators.
Space situational awareness: Commercial data processing for object tracking and conjunction analysis from non-classified sensor networks.
Launch and mission analytics: ML for commercial launch success prediction and mission planning optimization.
Cost: $45,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Cybersecurity
paragraphs: Colorado Springs's DoD-heavy population has created one of the US's densest cybersecurity communities — dozens of cybersecurity companies serve the military commands and their contractors. Commercial AI for cybersecurity:
Security operations center AI: SIEM alert triage, threat hunting automation, and incident response playbook automation for Colorado Springs's cybersecurity operations centers.
Network anomaly detection: ML for detecting unusual network behavior in enterprise environments serving Colorado Springs's defense and government-adjacent organizations.
Threat intelligence analytics: AI processing open-source and commercial threat intelligence feeds for Colorado Springs's cybersecurity community.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: UCHealth Memorial Hospital (Colorado Springs), Centura Health Colorado Springs, and Penrose-St. Francis Health Services. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Colorado Springs's health systems.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Outdoor Recreation and Tourism
paragraphs: Colorado Springs's outdoor economy — Pikes Peak, Garden of the Gods, and the destination recreation economy — creates demand analytics and customer AI for hospitality, outdoor retail, and tourism organizations.
Cost: $30,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks
